proposed_scope: One raised-wheel drive-only power-loss/restoration trial. After verified passive captures and operator arm, command right wheel +5 rpm once with left wheel zero. On POWER OFF NOW remove only drive power, confirm POWER_OFF, wait at least 3 seconds after normal stop, restore drive power once, observe at least 5 seconds with no restart, then remove drive power again. Accept either verified zero-first application recovery with no motion reauthorization or fail-closed can0 DOWN after a CAN error with no later RK3588 request. Require target candump and silent JCAN 207F346D5650, a post-motion drive boot-up frame, final drive power OFF, no automatic retry, no persistent drive write, no kernel/SDK change, and no JCAN TX.
